title: defaultIceServers adds to the fingerprinting surface
body: [defaultIceServers](http://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#widl-RTCPeerConnection-defaultIceServers) exposes potentially user-configured browser settings (e.g if users edit `media.peerconnection.default_iceservers` in _about:config_ in Firefox), so maybe it deserves a fingerprint warning, like is done elsewhere?
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
